name: Mudkip Goes to Walmart then Dies
source: The Adventures of Mudkip and Protagonist continue in Mudkip Goes to Walmart then Dies! Return to the world of Mudkip's Dating Simulator set weeks after the events of 1+2. (Note: Playing 1+2 not required to understand this game, and it's also worse) Mudkip is given a special task from Protagonist, and must carry it out with efficiency. How will Mudkip meet his demise? To whom will it be credited?
translation: 水跃鱼和主角的冒险在水跃鱼去沃尔玛然后死了！返回以1+2事件发生几周后为背景的Mudkip约会模拟器世界。（注：玩1+2不需要玩1+2来理解这个游戏，而且还更糟糕）泥鱼被主角交给了一个特殊的任务，必须高效地执行它。泥鱼鱼将如何面对他的灭亡？它将记入谁的贷方？
